residual_external_blockers.title: ADR-0011 pre-execution condition 4
residual_external_blockers.exact_missing_input: A merge into main of the current detailed protocol (docs/research/controlled-daily-v4-external-pergamino-protocol.md, HEAD sha256 e3fa7b6644171d0f80cfca6f3088e3e1fec44a0a6e63990deb05c26af5f8218a) and of the stage A/B/C runner implementation, so that the criteria under which a run would be judged are the ones merged in main.
residual_external_blockers.evidence_of_absence: git merge-base --is-ancestor 214735e42ee04f018156cd630591e798aadd8bf3 refs/remotes/origin/main exits 1; git diff --numstat origin/main HEAD on the protocol reports 42 additions / 2 deletions; origin/main lacks the section titled 'Condiciones de interpretacion y soporte previas a ejecucion' (numbered 16 in the branch, duplicating '16. Provenance', which IS in main).
residual_external_blockers.impact: No execution of A, B or C may begin. This is the binding blocker for the whole scientific campaign.
residual_external_blockers.minimal_external_action: Open a pull request from feat/scientific-closure (or a protocol-only branch) to main and merge it, then re-verify condition 4. Explicitly outside this session's authorization.
residual_external_blockers.why_not_derivable: The condition is normative and refers to the state of another branch. It cannot be satisfied by any local computation, and plan.md forbids inferring an exception.

residual_external_blockers.title: Approved container image not inspectable
residual_external_blockers.exact_missing_input: Access to a Docker daemon (or an equivalent rootless container runtime) from this WSL distro, so that 'docker image inspect sha256:55bc923e...b297af' can demonstrate the exact image ID.
residual_external_blockers.evidence_of_absence: docker version exits 1 ('could not be found in this WSL 2 distro'); /var/run/docker.sock absent; all Docker Desktop proxy sockets return 'permission denied' for uid 1000; podman/nerdctl/buildah absent; sudo requires interactive authentication.
residual_external_blockers.impact: The historic image identity cannot be certified. SC-GOV-009 cannot reach PASS on its image dimension.
residual_external_blockers.minimal_external_action: Enable Docker Desktop WSL integration for this distro, or grant this user access to a daemon socket.
residual_external_blockers.why_not_derivable: Rebuilding an image would produce a different digest and is explicitly forbidden from being claimed equivalent.

residual_external_blockers.title: Physically independent backup
residual_external_blockers.exact_missing_input: A writable, persistent filesystem on a block device distinct from /dev/sdf.
residual_external_blockers.evidence_of_absence: Only / (/dev/sdf, ext4) is writable and persistent for this user; /mnt/c is read-only 9p; /tmp is tmpfs. /dev/sdd (1 TiB, ext4) is present but unmounted and 'mount /dev/sdd /mnt' exits 32 ('must be superuser'); 'sudo -n true' exits 1.
residual_external_blockers.impact: SC-GOV-018 cannot reach full PASS; the second copy remains logical.
residual_external_blockers.minimal_external_action: An operator with root mounts /dev/sdd (or an external volume) at a writable path and grants this user write access.
residual_external_blockers.why_not_derivable: Physical independence is a property of storage topology, not of file content.
